question: Show the client names and their total amounts of books ordered.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "clients" AS SELECT "idclient" AS "idclient", "attribute" AS "attribute", "details" AS "details" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "orders" AS SELECT "idorder" AS "idorder", "idclient" AS "idclient", "dateorder" AS "dateorder", "dateexped" AS "dateexped" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "order_lines" AS SELECT "isbn" AS "isbn", "amount" AS "amount", "idorder_num" AS "idorder_num", "idorder_suffix" AS "idorder_suffix" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH client_names AS (
    SELECT CAST(idclient AS VARCHAR) AS idclient_str,
           details AS client_name
    FROM clients
    WHERE LOWER(attribute) = 'name'
),
assembled_lines AS (
    SELECT
        LPAD(CAST(idorder_num AS VARCHAR), 7, '0') || COALESCE(idorder_suffix, '') AS idorder,
        amount
    FROM order_lines
),
lines_with_clients AS (
    SELECT o.idclient AS idclient_str, al.amount
    FROM assembled_lines al
    JOIN orders o ON al.idorder = o.idorder
)
SELECT cn.client_name AS client, COALESCE(SUM(lc.amount),0) AS total_books_ordered
FROM client_names cn
LEFT JOIN lines_with_clients lc ON lc.idclient_str = cn.idclient_str
GROUP BY cn.client_name
ORDER BY total_books_ordered DESC, client ASC;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH client_names AS (
    SELECT CAST(idclient AS VARCHAR) AS idclient_str,
           details AS client
    FROM clients
    WHERE LOWER(attribute) = 'name'
),
orders_parsed AS (
    SELECT idorder,
           idclient AS idclient_str,
           TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(idorder, '^(\d+)') AS BIGINT) AS idorder_num
    FROM orders
),
lines_with_clients AS (
    SELECT op.idclient_str, ol.amount
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN orders_parsed op
      ON op.idorder_num = ol.idorder_num
)
SELECT cn.client,
       COALESCE(SUM(lc.amount), 0) AS total_books_ordered
FROM client_names cn
LEFT JOIN lines_with_clients lc
  ON lc.idclient_str = cn.idclient_str
GROUP BY cn.client
ORDER BY total_books_ordered DESC, client ASC;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH client_names AS (

assembled_lines AS (

ORDER BY total_books_ordered DESC, client ASC;
S:
# Join using exact idorder composed from numeric part zero-padded to 7 plus suffix; then aggregate per client.
query = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH client_names AS (
    SELECT CAST(idclient AS VARCHAR) AS idclient_str,
           details AS client
    FROM clients
    WHERE LOWER(attribute) = 'name'
),
assembled_lines AS (
    SELECT LPAD(CAST(idorder_num AS VARCHAR), 7, '0') || COALESCE(idorder_suffix, '') AS idorder,
           SUM(amount) AS amount
    FROM order_lines
    GROUP BY 1
),
lines_with_clients AS (
    SELECT o.idclient AS idclient_str, al.amount
    FROM assembled_lines al
    JOIN orders o ON al.idorder = o.idorder
)
SELECT cn.client,
       COALESCE(SUM(lc.amount), 0) AS total_books_ordered
FROM client_names cn
LEFT JOIN lines_with_clients lc
  ON lc.idclient_str = cn.idclient_str
GROUP BY cn.client
ORDER BY total_books_ordered DESC, client ASC;
'''
